models.name: Built-in Composer
models.description: Music-theory arranger. No download, no GPU, instant. Always available.
models.notes: Produces multi-track MIDI with drums, bass, chords, pad, arp and melody.

models.name: text2midi
models.description: Free-text prompt to MIDI. FLAN-T5 encoder with an autoregressive decoder.
models.notes: CPU inference is supported by the authors but slow: these models decode a token at a time, so a minute of music is tens of minutes of CPU. Use a GPU for anything interactive.

models.name: Anticipatory Music Transformer (small)
models.description: Symbolic generation and infilling. 128M params, but autoregressive: minutes of compute per minute of music on CPU.
models.notes: Trained on Lakh MIDI (CC-BY 4.0). Good at continuing and filling in existing material. Wants a GPU for interactive use; on CPU expect tens of minutes for a full piece.

models.name: MIDI Composer (skytnt)
models.description: ONNX symbolic model. Runs entirely on CPU, no torch required.
models.notes: Pin the revision: older ONNX exports are incompatible with current code. CPU-only by design, and still autoregressive, so long pieces take a while.

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5
models.description: Full-song generation with vocals. The closest open-weight analogue to Suno.
models.notes: First-party AMD support. Force the PyTorch LM backend on AMD; the vLLM default is CUDA-only. Roughly 30-60s per song on a 7900 XT under ROCm.

models.name: MusicGen Small
models.license_note: Weights are non-commercial. Code is MIT.
models.description: Instrumental clips up to 30 seconds. The most portable model here.
models.notes: Plain transformer over EnCodec. No exotic dependencies, runs anywhere torch runs.

models.name: MusicGen Medium
models.license_note: Weights are non-commercial. Code is MIT.
models.description: Better quality than Small, same 30-second ceiling.
models.notes: Noticeably slow on CPU; wants a GPU.

models.name: Stable Audio Open 1.0
models.license_note: Free below a revenue threshold; not an OSI open-source licence.
models.description: Loops, textures and sound effects up to about 47 seconds.
models.notes: Requires accepting the licence on Hugging Face and an access token.

models.name: DiffRhythm
models.description: Fast full-song latent diffusion. Potentially the quickest long-form option.
models.notes: Needs espeak-ng installed. Drop bitsandbytes from its requirements; it is training-only. Licence of the VAE component is the blocker, not the generator.
models.license_note: Generator weights badge Apache-2.0, but the required DiffRhythm-vae is under the Stability Community License, and DiffRhythm-1_2 declares no licence at all. Treat the whole pipeline as non-Apache until upstream clarifies.

dropped.name: YuE
dropped.reason: FlashAttention-2 is load-bearing for memory, not just speed, and there is no practical Windows build. Around 360s of compute per 30s of audio even on a 4090.

dropped.name: MiniMax Music 3
dropped.reason: Licence requires displaying MiniMax branding in the product UI, and there is no ROCm-on-Windows serving path. Revisit if that changes.
